scope.construct: method sensitivity of surface lexical amount, variety, and repetition

tokenizer.unit: ASCII alphabetic word with internal straight or curly apostrophes

metrics.types: number of distinct normalized tokenizer units
metrics.type_token_ratio: types divided by tokens; zero when tokens is zero
metrics.hapax_types: number of normalized types occurring exactly once

fergadiotis-wright-green-2015.citation: Fergadiotis, G., Wright, H. H., & Green, S. B. (2015). Psychometric evaluation of lexical diversity indices: Assessing length effects. Journal of Speech, Language, and Hearing Research, 58(3), 840–852.
fergadiotis-wright-green-2015.supports_ja: TTRの標本長による交絡と、構成概念妥当性を実装一致から推定できないという解釈境界。

zenker-kyle-2021.citation: Zenker, F., & Kyle, K. (2021). Investigating minimum text lengths for lexical diversity indices. Assessing Writing, 47, 100505.
zenker-kyle-2021.supports_ja: 単純TTRの定義と、当該L2論証エッセイ標本の50–200 token範囲で観測された長さ依存性。

reference_scope: The references support the stated TTR definition and interpretation limits; they do not validate this application, its tokenizer, bundled scenarios, or any population inference.
limitations: type_token_ratio is length-sensitive and is not a cross-text quality score
with both texts fixed at 100 tokens, type_token_ratio is exactly types divided by 100 and is not independent evidence
sentence punctuation is discarded, so segmentation-only changes are invariant by design for every displayed metric
the nested-length scenario changes both sample size and accumulated lexical composition and does not identify a sentence-count effect
the bundled pair controls token count and sentence frames but not lexical frequency, semantics, familiarity, or naturalness
the visible contrast was deliberately engineered and is not an effect estimate for naturally occurring text

the workspace supports one text, researcher-declared line units, a descriptive two-text difference, or a descriptive document batch and provides no automatic sentence-level group-level or inferential analysis
declared-segment mode treats non-empty lines as researcher-declared units and does not perform automatic sentence segmentation
declared segments within one text are not independent authors participants or population observations
documents in a batch are not assumed to be independent participants and the unweighted distribution is not a population estimate
the rights attestation is supplied by the researcher and is not independently verified by the application
the SHA-256 identifies the analyzed UTF-8 string but is not anonymization and the metadata-only export cannot reproduce a result without the separately preserved source text
the exported hash and client-clock timestamp are not a signature proof of authorship or trusted proof of when analysis occurred and the JSON can be edited after export
implementation parity does not establish construct validity

presentation.comparison_direction: second sample minus first sample within the selected scenario

relationship_meanings.single: one declared text span; no difference
relationship_meanings.declared-segments: one text containing two or more researcher-declared non-empty line units; no between-participant inference
relationship_meanings.paired: two deliberately related texts; second minus first
relationship_meanings.independent: two separately sampled texts; descriptive second-minus-first difference only
relationship_meanings.batch: two to one hundred researcher-identified documents; per-document values and unweighted descriptive distribution only

workspace.input_identifier: trimmed case-sensitive id unique within each exported record
workspace.record_timestamp: required exact Date.toISOString UTC string from the client clock; not a trusted timestamp signature or evidence of analysis time
workspace.metadata_normalization: trim leading and trailing whitespace from id label provenance and sampling/comparison design; preserve text exactly
workspace.unicode_validation: reject strings containing unpaired UTF-16 surrogates before UTF-8 hashing or export; requires String.prototype.isWellFormed
workspace.declared_segment_rule: split exact input at LF or CRLF; ignore whitespace-only lines; preserve non-empty line order; do not infer sentences
workspace.declared_segment_summary: unweighted minimum median and maximum across declared lines; even-count median is the arithmetic mean of the two middle values; descriptive only
workspace.batch_input: JSON array of objects with unique id label provenance and text strings; preserve array order; all-or-nothing validation
workspace.batch_summary: unweighted minimum median and maximum across documents; no pooled score groups ranking or inference

warning_meanings_ja.descriptive-only: 表示値は入力テキストと指定手続きの記述であり、評価・診断・統計推測ではない。
warning_meanings_ja.ttr-length-sensitive: TTRは標本長に依存するため、長さの異なるテキストを単純順位化できない。
warning_meanings_ja.no-recognized-tokens: 現在のASCII英語tokenizerが認識したtokenが0件の入力を含む。
warning_meanings_ja.researcher-declared-segments: 各単位は自動文分割ではなく、研究者が改行で宣言した非空行である。
warning_meanings_ja.segments-not-independent-observations: 同一テキスト内の行を独立した著者・参加者・母集団標本として扱えない。
warning_meanings_ja.pooled-and-segment-statistics-not-equiva: 全文をpoolした値と行別値の分布・平均は異なる量であり、置き換えられない。
warning_meanings_ja.batch-documents-not-independent: バッチ内の文書を独立した参加者・母集団標本とは仮定していない。依存関係は設計メモで管理する必要がある。
warning_meanings_ja.batch-summary-unweighted: 文書別分布は各文書を1行として等しく数えた記述値であり、pool値・順位・母集団推定ではない。
warning_meanings_ja.types-and-ttr-algebraically-dependent-at: 同じtoken数ではTypes差とTTR差は代数的に従属し、独立した証拠ではない。
warning_meanings_ja.cross-length-difference-confounded: token数が異なるため、TTR差には長さと語彙構成が同時に関与する。
warning_meanings_ja.independent-texts-not-causal: 独立した2テキストの差だけでは、母集団差や因果効果を推論できない。

retention.user_source: live form memory only; application performs no durable write
retention.clear_control: explicit reset and best-effort pagehide reset; browser or device memory/history erasure is not guaranteed

benchmark_mwe_evaluation.scope: Open-text English VPC.full, VPC.semi, and VID evaluation under resources/evaluation_strata.json; separate from the browser lexical-diversity probe above.

gold_documents.occurrence_rule: Discovery-complete adjudicated candidate records; confirmed records define the positive occurrence population and assessed rejected records may define literal negatives.

system_predictions.coverage_rule: Exactly one prediction document per gold document; zero or more unique proposed member spans per document.

input_schemas.probabilistic_extension: When system.probabilistic is true, every emitted candidate requires confirmed_probability in [0,1].
input_schemas.selective_extension: When system.selective is true, every emitted candidate requires decision_confidence in [0,1].

bootstrap_contributions.scope: One metric per file for the dependency-free command-line ratio adapter; non-additive metrics reuse the same library resampler with a raw-record estimator callback.
bootstrap_contributions.weight_rule: Use the frozen document inverse-inclusion-probability weight; use 1 only for unweighted descriptive checks.
bootstrap_contributions.row_rule: Every row belongs to exactly one document and canonical type and carries every requested single-axis stratum value; all rows from a resampled cluster travel together.

common_rules.reporting: Always retain numerator, denominator, value, document count, canonical-form count, and estimate state; do not silently drop multiple assignment, ambiguity, abstention, out-of-inventory, inventory-ineligible records, or zero denominators.

bootstrap.interval: Percentile interval with type-7 linear interpolation at 0.025 and 0.975; retain the IR-125 point-estimate formula in every resample.
bootstrap.primary_design: Resample document_id clusters with replacement independently within each populated sampling length stratum, preserving its realized document count and keeping every row from a selected document together.
bootstrap.design_weight: Apply the frozen inverse-inclusion-probability document weight inside every point estimate and resample.
bootstrap.secondary_sensitivity: Separately resample canonical_type_id clusters globally with replacement, keeping all rows for a selected type together; this sensitivity does not replace the document-primary interval.
bootstrap.paired_comparison: Use the identical cluster draw for all systems and calculate every reported difference as later-listed system minus earlier-listed system.
bootstrap.prespecified_strata: Filter to each requested frozen single-axis level, then call the same point-estimate and cluster-resampling functions used for overall results.
bootstrap.degenerate: If any populated resampling stratum has fewer than two clusters, report point estimates only and no interval or comparative inference.
bootstrap.undefined_resample: If any requested bootstrap replicate has an undefined metric denominator, withhold that interval and report the defined replicate count; do not silently discard replicates.
bootstrap.claim_state: All intervals remain descriptive until IR-127 prospectively freezes and passes allocation, cluster-count, and precision gates.

candidate_recall.formula: One-to-one recovered confirmed gold occurrences matched by document_id and the gold first member token (the verbal head in this contract); span correctness is not required here.
candidate_recall.denominator: All confirmed gold occurrences in discovery-complete evaluation documents.
candidate_recall.undefined: null when there are no confirmed gold occurrences.

exact_span_prf.input: confirmed gold member-token sets + confirmed system member-token sets
exact_span_prf.formula: Exact document-and-member-set match; report precision, recall, and F1 separately.
exact_span_prf.denominator: Precision: confirmed system spans; recall: confirmed gold spans; F1: their summed counts.
exact_span_prf.undefined: Each component is null when its denominator is zero.

member_token_prf.input: unique (document_id, member_token_id) pairs from confirmed gold and system spans
member_token_prf.formula: Set intersection precision, recall, and F1; gap tokens never count as members.
member_token_prf.denominator: Precision: predicted member-token pairs; recall: gold member-token pairs; F1: their summed counts.
member_token_prf.undefined: Each component is null when its denominator is zero.

member_set_accuracy.input: confirmed gold spans + confirmed system spans
member_set_accuracy.formula: Confirmed gold occurrences with an exact predicted member set divided by confirmed gold occurrences.
member_set_accuracy.undefined: null when there are no confirmed gold occurrences.

gap_set_accuracy.input: gap_token_ids for exact confirmed member-set matches
gap_set_accuracy.formula: Confirmed gold occurrences whose exact predicted span also has the exhaustive gold gap set divided by confirmed gold occurrences.
gap_set_accuracy.denominator: All confirmed gold occurrences; missing or inexact system spans are incorrect.
gap_set_accuracy.undefined: null when there are no confirmed gold occurrences.

category_macro_f1.input: exact confirmed spans with gold and predicted category in VPC.full, VPC.semi, or VID
category_macro_f1.formula: Unweighted mean of the three one-vs-rest category F1 values; also report every per-category P/R/F1.
category_macro_f1.denominator: Exactly three frozen categories; each category F1 uses predicted-category count plus gold-category count.
category_macro_f1.undefined: null if any category has zero gold and zero predicted instances; name every undefined category.

idiomaticity_prediction_coverage.input: gold candidate records with idiomatic, literal, or ambiguous status + exact-span predictions
idiomaticity_prediction_coverage.formula: Records receiving a non-not_assessed system label divided by eligible gold records.
idiomaticity_prediction_coverage.denominator: All scheduled and gold-assessed idiomaticity records, including retained literal negatives.
idiomaticity_prediction_coverage.undefined: null when no gold record is assessed for idiomaticity.

idiomaticity_accuracy_among_predictions.formula: Exact status matches divided by non-not_assessed system labels.
idiomaticity_accuracy_among_predictions.denominator: Gold-assessed records receiving a system idiomaticity label.
idiomaticity_accuracy_among_predictions.undefined: null when the system supplies no eligible idiomaticity label.

gold_idiomaticity_ambiguity_rate.formula: Gold ambiguous records divided by gold-assessed idiomaticity records.
gold_idiomaticity_ambiguity_rate.denominator: All gold records with idiomatic, literal, or ambiguous status.
gold_idiomaticity_ambiguity_rate.undefined: null when no gold record is assessed for idiomaticity.

occurrence_sense_inventory_coverage.input: sense lookup records for confirmed gold occurrences
occurrence_sense_inventory_coverage.formula: Matched inventory lookups divided by confirmed gold occurrences.
occurrence_sense_inventory_coverage.denominator: All confirmed gold occurrences, including not-attempted, out-of-inventory, and inventory-ineligible records.
occurrence_sense_inventory_coverage.undefined: null when there are no confirmed gold occurrences.

canonical_form_sense_inventory_coverage.input: sense lookup records grouped by canonical_form for confirmed gold occurrences
canonical_form_sense_inventory_coverage.formula: Distinct canonical forms with at least one matched lookup divided by represented confirmed-gold forms.
canonical_form_sense_inventory_coverage.denominator: All distinct canonical forms represented by confirmed gold occurrences.
canonical_form_sense_inventory_coverage.undefined: null when no canonical form has a confirmed gold occurrence.
canonical_form_sense_inventory_coverage.bootstrap_unit: document_id; canonical_type_id is the required secondary sensitivity unit

occurrence_gold_out_of_inventory_rate.input: sense assignment status for confirmed gold occurrences
occurrence_gold_out_of_inventory_rate.formula: Gold out_of_inventory assignments divided by confirmed gold occurrences.
occurrence_gold_out_of_inventory_rate.undefined: null when there are no confirmed gold occurrences.

canonical_form_gold_out_of_inventory_rat.input: sense assignment records grouped by canonical_form for confirmed gold occurrences
canonical_form_gold_out_of_inventory_rat.formula: Distinct canonical forms with at least one out_of_inventory assignment divided by represented confirmed-gold forms.
canonical_form_gold_out_of_inventory_rat.denominator: All distinct canonical forms represented by confirmed gold occurrences.
canonical_form_gold_out_of_inventory_rat.undefined: null when no canonical form has a confirmed gold occurrence.
canonical_form_gold_out_of_inventory_rat.bootstrap_unit: document_id; canonical_type_id is the required secondary sensitivity unit

occurrence_gold_inventory_ineligible_rat.input: sense assignment status for confirmed gold occurrences
occurrence_gold_inventory_ineligible_rat.formula: Gold inventory_ineligible assignments divided by confirmed gold occurrences.
occurrence_gold_inventory_ineligible_rat.undefined: null when there are no confirmed gold occurrences.

sense_prediction_coverage.input: gold assigned/multiple_assigned/ambiguous reference sets + exact-span system sense states
sense_prediction_coverage.formula: System assigned/multiple_assigned/ambiguous records divided by eligible reference sets.
sense_prediction_coverage.denominator: Confirmed gold occurrences with a nonempty assigned, multiple_assigned, or ambiguous reference set; gold OOI and inventory-ineligible cases are excluded and reported separately.
sense_prediction_coverage.undefined: null when there is no eligible gold reference set.

sense_assignment_state_accuracy.input: gold and exact-span system sense_assignment_status for eligible reference sets
sense_assignment_state_accuracy.formula: Exact assigned/multiple_assigned/ambiguous state matches divided by eligible gold reference sets; missing spans and abstentions are incorrect.
sense_assignment_state_accuracy.undefined: null when there is no eligible gold reference set.

sense_exact_set_accuracy.input: gold and system selected_sense_ids for eligible reference sets
sense_exact_set_accuracy.formula: Exact unordered set matches divided by eligible gold reference sets; missing spans and abstentions are incorrect.
sense_exact_set_accuracy.undefined: null when there is no eligible gold reference set.

sense_micro_f1.input: gold and system selected (occurrence, sense_id) pairs for eligible reference sets
sense_micro_f1.formula: Micro precision, recall, and F1 over label-pair intersections.
sense_micro_f1.denominator: Precision: predicted label pairs; recall: gold label pairs; F1: their summed counts.
sense_micro_f1.undefined: Each component is null when its denominator is zero.

sense_macro_f1.input: per-occurrence gold and system sense sets for eligible reference sets
sense_macro_f1.formula: Unweighted mean of per-occurrence set F1, with missing spans and abstentions scoring zero.
sense_macro_f1.undefined: null when there is no eligible gold reference set.

gold_sense_ambiguity_rate.formula: Gold ambiguous assignments divided by confirmed gold occurrences.
gold_sense_ambiguity_rate.undefined: null when there are no confirmed gold occurrences.

gold_multiple_assignment_rate.formula: Gold multiple_assigned assignments divided by confirmed gold occurrences.
gold_multiple_assignment_rate.undefined: null when there are no confirmed gold occurrences.

model_abstention_rate.input: exact-span system sense assignment statuses for eligible reference sets
model_abstention_rate.formula: System abstained states divided by eligible gold reference sets.
model_abstention_rate.denominator: All eligible gold reference sets, whether or not the system emits a sense.
model_abstention_rate.undefined: null when there is no eligible gold reference set.

model_out_of_inventory_rate.input: exact-span system sense assignment statuses for eligible reference sets
model_out_of_inventory_rate.formula: System out_of_inventory states divided by eligible gold reference sets.
model_out_of_inventory_rate.undefined: null when there is no eligible gold reference set.

candidates_per_document.input: all emitted system candidates + evaluation documents
candidates_per_document.formula: Emitted candidate count divided by document count.
candidates_per_document.denominator: All evaluation documents, including documents with zero candidates.
candidates_per_document.undefined: null when there are no evaluation documents.

brier_score.input: confirmed_probability and exact gold occurrence indicator for every emitted candidate; probabilistic systems only
brier_score.undefined: not_applicable for nonprobabilistic systems; null when a probabilistic system emits no candidate.

log_loss.input: same candidate probabilities and binary indicators as brier_score; probabilistic systems only
log_loss.undefined: not_applicable for nonprobabilistic systems; null with no candidate; state=infinite with a null JSON value when a zero-probability true outcome occurs.

expected_calibration_error.input: same candidate probabilities and binary indicators as brier_score; probabilistic systems only
expected_calibration_error.formula: Weighted absolute confidence-accuracy gap over ten fixed equal-width bins on [0,1].
expected_calibration_error.denominator: All emitted candidates; empty bins contribute zero.
expected_calibration_error.undefined: not_applicable for nonprobabilistic systems; null when a probabilistic system emits no candidate.

risk_coverage_curve.input: terminal system decisions and decision_confidence; selective systems only
risk_coverage_curve.formula: Sort terminal decisions by descending confidence with stable item-ID ties; at each rank report errors/rank against rank/all emitted candidates coverage.
risk_coverage_curve.denominator: Risk: retained terminal decisions; coverage: all emitted candidates.
risk_coverage_curve.undefined: not_applicable for nonselective systems; empty curve when there is no terminal decision.

aurc.formula: Arithmetic mean of observed prefix risks; report maximum decision coverage separately.
aurc.undefined: not_applicable for nonselective systems; null when there is no terminal decision.
